name: Civic Engagement & Governance
short: Turning young Nigerians from spectators of governance into participants in it.
description: The programme's founding purpose: mobilising young people to take part in governance and the political process at ward, local government and state level. Coordinating units run civic-education sessions, voter-awareness drives and town halls that connect young people to the officials who represent them.
programmes: Ward-level civic education and voter awareness
Youth town halls with elected representatives
Governance literacy briefings on federal and state programmes

name: Peace & Non-Violence
short: Participation without violence, hate speech, intimidation or misinformation.
description: A standing charge of the programme, repeated at every state inauguration: young people are urged to participate actively in politics while rejecting violence, hate speech, intimidation and the spread of false information. Coordinating units run peace messaging, fact-checking drives and conflict de-escalation training ahead of and between electoral cycles.
programmes: Anti-hate-speech and anti-misinformation campaigns
Peace advocacy with religious and traditional institutions
Conflict de-escalation training for ward mobilisers

name: Leadership & Capacity Building
short: Training the coordinators who carry the programme into 774 local governments.
description: Leadership and organisational training for the coordinators, ward mobilisers and volunteers who make up the programme's structure — covering public speaking, community organising, programme management and accountability in the handling of public trust.
programmes: National and zonal coordinator induction
Community organising and mobilisation training
Mentorship pairings with public officials and professionals

name: Digital Skills & Innovation
short: Digital capability as the fastest route from training to income.
description: Signposting and delivering digital skills training for young Nigerians, and connecting them to existing federal skills and financing programmes. Coordinating units host training clusters and help young people navigate national schemes rather than duplicating them.
programmes: Digital skills training clusters at state level
Signposting to federal skills and technology programmes
Innovation and content-creation showcases

name: Education & Student Support
short: Making sure no young Nigerian misses school for want of information.
description: Awareness and application support for education financing — including the student loan scheme highlighted by the National Coordinator at state inaugurations — plus campus outreach and support for young people returning to education.
programmes: Student loan scheme awareness and application clinics
Campus chapter outreach
Scholarship and bursary signposting

name: Agriculture & Agripreneurship
short: Young people in farming as a business, not a fallback.
description: Encouraging young Nigerians into agriculture as an enterprise — linking them to land, inputs, extension advice and markets through state coordinating units, and profiling young farmers who have built viable businesses.
programmes: Young farmers' clusters at local government level
Input, land and market linkage support
Agribusiness enterprise profiling

name: Enterprise & Employment
short: Connecting trained young people to capital, customers and work.
description: Enterprise support and employment linkage — connecting young people to credit schemes, business registration, and employment initiatives run by federal and state agencies, and convening employers at state level.
programmes: Enterprise and access-to-finance clinics
Business registration and formalisation support
Employer engagement and job-linkage events

name: Inclusion — Young Women & PWDs
short: A structure that is not complete until it includes everyone.
description: Deliberate inclusion of young women and young persons with disabilities across every level of the programme's structure, with dedicated leadership positions and accessibility requirements for programme activities.
programmes: Young women's leadership positions at every level
Accessibility standards for programme activities
Outreach to out-of-school and rural young people
